description: NLS Hypothalamus hormone configuration, rebalanced for AI timescale. Human brains operate on hour-long cycles; NLS operates on ~10-second turn cycles. v1.1 compressed half-lives and lowered production rates so hormones can spike, influence, and recover within a 100-turn session. v1.2 adds autoreceptor negative feedback (per-hormone autoreceptor_gain) and rectified interactions. v1.3 rebalances cortisol for agentic loops: halved half-life (180s→90s), reduced production rate (0.12→0.08), stronger autoreceptor (1.2→2.0), lower tool_error magnitude (0.45→0.25), stronger tool_success relief (-0.3→-0.4). Prevents 1-2 recoverable tool errors from spiking cortisol to abort thresholds.

cortisol.description: Stress response. Increases caution, self-monitoring, and verification. The system becomes more careful after errors.
cortisol.brain_analog: Cortisol -- released by adrenal glands in response to stress. AI-scaled: 90s half-life (v1.3: halved from 180s so stress recovers faster during rapid agentic iterations where turns happen every 3-5s, not minutes). Human: 60-90min.

Cholinergic system is the master modulator of attention and memory encoding. Extended from 2min to 3min to reflect richer post-conversation processing with tool use (browser, bash, file operations generate more material to mentally digest).
